rows.text_en: Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries ( Coastal Shipping Division ), 051-773-5731, 5732

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「한국해운조합법」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다. <개정 2011. 8. 5.>
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Korea Shipping Association Act and its Enforcement Decree, as well as matters necessary for its implementation. <Amended Aug. 5, 2011>

rows.source_ko: 제2조(공제규정) 「한국해운조합법」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제6조의2제1항에 따라 공제규정에 적어야 할 사항은 다음 각 호와 같다. <개정 2011. 8. 5., 2016. 11. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Mutual Aid Provisions) Pursuant to Article 6-2, Paragraph 1 of the Korea Shipping Association Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”), the matters to be specified in the Mutual Aid Provisions are as follows: <Amended Aug. 5, 2011; Nov. 30, 2016>
1. Matters concerning implementation methods by scope of mutual aid business
2. Matters concerning the contents of the insurance contract

rows.source_ko: 3. 공제료에 관한 다음 각 목의 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning deductions in each of the following subparagraphs

rows.source_ko: 가. 공제료의 수납 및 환급에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: a. Matters concerning the collection and refund of deductions
B. Method of Calculating the Deduction Rate
C. Matters concerning the collection of deductions

rows.source_ko: 4. 공제금에 관한 다음 각 목의 사항
rows.text_en: 4. The following matters regarding deductions

rows.source_ko: 가. 책임준비금 및 비상위험준비금의 계상ㆍ적립ㆍ관리에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: a. Matters concerning the calculation, accumulation, and management of liability reserves and contingency reserves
B. Matters concerning the payment of deductions
5. Purpose of the Mutual Aid Program
6. Matters concerning the scope of deduction and implementation
7. Limits and Eligibility for Deduction
8. Matters concerning the organization in charge of mutual aid business

rows.source_ko: 9. 조난에 관한 보고와 구조비 지급에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 9. Matters concerning reporting of distress and payment of rescue expenses

rows.source_ko: 10. 공제사업 실시에 필요한 조사와 지시에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 10. Matters concerning investigations and instructions necessary for the implementation of the mutual aid business
11. Method for Determining Ship Valuation Criteria
12. Matters concerning expenses necessary for the mutual aid business

rows.source_ko: 13. 한국해운조합에 두는 공제분쟁심의위원회의 설치 및 운영에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 13. Matters concerning the establishment and operation of the Mutual Aid Dispute Deliberation Committee within the Korea Shipping Association

rows.source_ko: 14. 그 밖에 공제사업을 운영하는 데에 필요한 사항
rows.text_en: 14. Other matters necessary for operating the mutual aid business
Article 3 Deleted <April 22, 1996>
Article 4 Deleted <2016. 11. 30.>
ADDENDA <Ministry of Transportation Decree No. 593, May 16, 1978>

rows.source_ko: ①(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날로부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: ① (Enforcement Date) This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
② (Repealed Act) The Rules on the Regulations of the Korea Shipping Association Mutual Aid are hereby repealed.

rows.source_ko: ③(경과조치) 이 규칙 시행당시 한국해운조합공제규정에관한규칙에 의하여 처리된 사항은 이 규칙에 의하여 처리된 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: ③ (Transitional Measures) Matters processed pursuant to the Rules on the Regulations on Mutual Aid of the Korea Shipping Association at the time of the enforcement of this Rule shall be deemed to have been processed pursuant to this Rule.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Construction and Transportation Decree No. 63, Apr. 22, 1996>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Construction and Transportation Decree No. 188, May 21, 2001>
This rule shall take effect on July 1, 2001.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Land, Transport and Maritime Affairs Decree No. 368, Aug. 5, 2011>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries Decree No. 205, Nov. 30, 2016>
This rule shall take effect on November 30, 2016.
